description: Is a website down? Resolves its DNS and loads the URL once (10 s timeout) from FernTool's Cloudflare edge, then returns verdict (up/down), reason (ok, blocked_bot, page_not_found, server_error, timeout, tls, dns_nxdomain...), HTTP status, response time, final URL after redirects and server country/network. One vantage point only; results cached 30 s.

url.description: Website address, e.g. example.com or https://example.com/page

name: check_website_status
